The Problems on the Factory Floor

Factories are running. But are they truly under control?

Most plants operate on gut feeling and delayed spreadsheets — not live data. That gap is where cost, downtime, and waste quietly accumulate.

◐

No Real-Time Visibility

Machine and utility status stay locked in isolated panels, invisible to the people who need them.

◔

Manual Reporting Delays

Shift reports built by hand arrive hours — sometimes days — after the moment they describe.

⚡

Hidden Energy Losses

Peak-demand spikes and idle-load waste go unnoticed until the utility bill lands.

⏱

Unplanned Downtime

Breakdowns surface as a stoppage, not as an early warning that could have been actioned.

◑

Low Production Efficiency

Line-level bottlenecks stay buried inside aggregate numbers nobody has time to unpack.

✕

Late Defect Detection

Quality issues are caught downstream, after material and labor are already spent.

◒

Utility Wastage

Water, steam, gas, and compressed air leaks run for weeks before anyone notices.

▦

Scattered Data

PLCs, meters, ERP, and MES each hold a fragment — none of them talk to each other.
